page_title: RBL 1-3 LEV | RB Leipzig v Bayer Leverkusen 20/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' That's the end of the match.
90+11' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) is cautioned by the referee.
90+10' Benjamin Brand sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+9' The Bayer Leverkusen players halt their celebrations as referee Benjamin Brand makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.

90+7' 1 - 3 GOAL! Montrell Culbreath (Bayer Leverkusen) receives the ball after a swift counter attack. Still with some work to do, he weaves his way through the defence to score a wonderful goal from close range to make it 1:3.
90+7' Surely that's handball by one of the Bayer Leverkusen players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90+6' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+5' Mark Flekken makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) after a cross from the side.
90+5' One of the players from Bayer Leverkusen times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+4' The ball goes out for a corner. Bayer Leverkusen can continue in their attacking effort.
90+4' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) shoots the rebound towards the goal. His effort lacks pace and that allows the goalkeeper to pull off a stunning save.

90+4' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Peter Gulacsi anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
90+2' The corner kick from Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a cross from the corner, but Peter Gulacsi reads it well and gathers the ball.
89' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nicolas Seiwald as he is replaced by El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig).

89' Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. It will be a corner kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
87' The game has begun to heat up. Axel Tape (Bayer Leverkusen) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
86' A player from Bayer Leverkusen commits a rough challenge. Benjamin Brand blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
85' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
83' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to substitute Arthur and he is replaced by Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen).
82' The shot by Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Mark Flekken.
81' 8:10 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Timo Werner (RB Leipzig) coming on for Tidiam Gomis.
78' The attendance is 45000.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Axel Tape (Bayer Leverkusen) will replace Nathan Tella.
77' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to make a change. Montrell Culbreath (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Martin Terrier.
77' The substitution is prepared. Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Patrik Schick.
76' Andrija Maksimovic (RB Leipzig) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
74' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
73' David Raum (RB Leipzig) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
71' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a rough challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Romulo Cardoso is replaced by Andrija Maksimovic (RB Leipzig).
70' Substitution. Kosta Nedeljkovic leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig).
69' Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
68' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 16:10.
66' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
64' Bayer Leverkusen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
63' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

63' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayer Leverkusen are going to take it.
61' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but his shot missed the target close to the right post.
59' Mark Flekken displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
57' Jonas Hofmann comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen).
55' 40:60 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
53' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
52' Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the right post.
51' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
49' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Mark Flekken makes a save.
48' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
46' RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Peter Gulacsi to make a comfortable save.
45+1' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) meets a cross inside the box, but Mark Flekken wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 1 - 2 Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort goes under the crossbar and into the net.
43' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
42' RB Leipzig players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
40' 1 - 1 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Arthur is pounced on by Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen). His close-range header flashes past Peter Gulacsi and into the top left corner. 1:1.
39' 1:3 – the corner kicks stats.
38' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
37' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
35' 1 - 0 Goal! Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
33' The ball is cleared after Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
32' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the right side of the goal, but Mark Flekken makes a magnificent save!
30' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) was quite harsh and Benjamin Brand didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
30' One of the RB Leipzig players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
28' Bayer Leverkusen are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
26' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:5.

24' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning.
23' The resulting corner, taken by Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen), comes to nothing.
22' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.

21' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Peter Gulacsi pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner kick.
19' The ball goes out of play. RB Leipzig are awarded a corner kick.
18' Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
16' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) serves up a nice cross, but Peter Gulacsi punches the ball away.
15' David Raum (RB Leipzig) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Mark Flekken.

14' Jeanuel Belocian (Bayer Leverkusen) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Benjamin Brand no option but to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to RB Leipzig, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
13' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post!
12' The percentage of ball possession is – 39:61.
10' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
9' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

7' That was a nice football moment. Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom left corner. Mark Flekken guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!

6' Ambitious effort from Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.

5' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Peter Gulacsi pulls off a comfortable save.
3' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
Benjamin Brand is introduced as the referee for today's match.
